cards.text: Grab a clipboard, friend, because here comes the list of Israel's heads of families, the commanders of thousands and of hundreds, and the officers who served the king. David's army is split into divisions. And together those divisions have the WHOLE year to cover.

cards.question: David's army divisions had the whole year to cover. How did they serve the king?

answers.text: Each division took its own month
Every division served all year long
Each division served only in wartime

cards.text: Then come the twelve divisions, one for each month, each with 24,000 men and a commander in charge. One name to spot is Benaiah son of Jehoiada the priest, mighty among the Thirty, who takes the third month. Twelve crews, and every crew knows its month. Friend, I can't even remember what day I last cleaned my oven.

Next comes a list of the leaders over the tribes of Israel, with Zadok over Aaron's family too. Over Judah is Elihu, one of David's brothers. Picture family game night at THAT house. "Your turn, Elihu." "That's SIR Elihu to you."

cards.question: Then the list pauses for something David did NOT do. Which men did David leave out of his count?

answers.text: Men over the age of sixty
Men from the tribe of Levi

cards.question: David left the men aged twenty or under out of the count. Why?

answers.text: The LORD said Israel would be as many as the stars
The LORD said only older men would go to battle
The army leaders said they already had plenty of men

cards.text: Then Joab son of Zeruiah gets to work and starts counting the men. Hold on to your apron, friend.

cards.question: Joab finished counting all the men.
Joab's census didn't go well. Because of it, ___ came upon Israel.
Joab never finished his count. The number from it was entered in the Book of the Chronicles of King David.

cards.text: Next up are the officials in charge of King David's property: storehouses, fields, vineyards, olive and sycamore trees, olive oil, herds, camels, donkeys and flocks. Obil the Ishmaelite gets the camels. Friend, I'm in charge of ONE oven, and some days the oven is STILL winning.

Last come the people around the king himself: counselors like David's uncle Jonathan and Ahithophel, a man who looks after the king's sons, and Joab over the whole army. And Hushai the Archite? Listed as the king's friend. An OFFICIAL title, friend. I shared a junk drawer with an expired coupon for years, and neither one of us ever got a title.
